empty.title: Follow the stage of each conversation
empty.description: A funnel is the path of your support, from first contact to closing. You choose the stages and drag conversations from one to the next, and conversion shows up on its own.

create.title: New funnel
create.description: Give it a name and say which stages a conversation goes through.

delete.title: Delete the funnel {{name}}?
delete.description: Conversations stay in chat and only leave this funnel. The stages and each conversation's position in them are gone, and this can't be undone.

form.name: Funnel name
form.stagesHint: In the order a conversation moves forward, first to last. Drag to change the order. Enter creates the next one.
form.stageDuplicate: There's already a stage with this name.
form.stagesRequired: A funnel needs at least one stage.
form.tooManyStages: A funnel can have up to {{max}} stages.
form.removedStage_one: {{name}} will be deleted when you save. {{count}} conversation goes to "No stage".
form.removedStage_other: {{name}} will be deleted when you save. {{count}} conversations go to "No stage".
form.removedStageEmpty: {{name}} will be deleted when you save. No conversations are in it.
form.removedHint_one: {{names}} stops existing, and {{count}} conversation goes to "No stage". Conversations aren't deleted.
form.removedHint_other: {{names}} stops existing, and {{count}} conversations go to "No stage". Conversations aren't deleted.
form.removedHintEmpty: {{names}} stops existing. No conversations are there.

stage.name: Stage name
stage.addAfter: Create a stage after this one
stage.deleteHint_one: The conversation in it goes to "No stage". It isn't deleted, and you can move it again.
stage.deleteHint_other: The {{count}} conversations in it go to "No stage". They aren't deleted, and you can move them again.
stage.deleteHintEmpty: No conversations are in this stage, in this view. If there are others, they go to "No stage".

filters.showNoStageHint: Conversations from this period that aren't in any stage yet.

metrics.title: Funnel conversion
metrics.description_one: {{total}} conversation in this view, {{noStage}} with no stage.
metrics.description_other: {{total}} conversations in this view, {{noStage}} with no stage.

notice.noResultsHint: Try another assignee, another tag or another search.
notice.noChatsHint_one: Nothing in the last day. Widen the period to see more conversations.
notice.noChatsHint_other: Nothing in the last {{count}} days. Widen the period to see more conversations.
notice.startTitle: Now, put conversations into the stages
notice.startHint: They all start in "No stage". Drag each conversation to the stage it's in, or use "Move to another stage" on the card.

card.sentByUs: Sent by the team or by automation

dnd.instructions: To move the card, press Space. Use the left and right arrows to choose the stage. Press Space again to drop it, or Esc to cancel. Enter opens the details.
dnd.picked: Picked up {{name}}. Use the arrows to choose the stage.

move.title: Move to another stage
move.failed: The conversation with {{name}} went back where it was. {{reason}}

panel.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, or it's outside what you can see.
